name: Parakeet Cafe - Coronado
notes: Own multi-location site (parakeetcafe.com/coronado-menu) lists dishes with no prices; the restaurant's own unPLUG Dining ordering platform (orders.parakeetcafe.com, restaurantId=681) resolves to "Parakeet Cafe Coronado" specifically and shows full pricing, confirmed via browser render (address matches batch, 1134 Orange Ave). Prices are clean .00/.50/.75/.95/.45, no markup pattern. Dropped the "Featured" carousel (duplicated items already listed elsewhere) except the 4 seasonal Pumpkin Spice drinks which were Featured-only, filed under Coffee & Espresso / Matcha. Dropped 3 duplicate cross-listings (Sweet Treat Acai under Kids Food, Lemonade under Kids Beverages, and 3 Pastries items re-listed under Market) keeping one canonical entry each. 189 dishes across 24 sections; note "Bowls" is split into "Bowls (Savory)" and "Bowls (Smoothie)" since the site uses that name twice for different things. A few items (Brekkie Croissant Sandwich, 2 Croissant varieties, Golden Bowl, Cold Press Orange, Matcha Tin, Coconut Chia Pudding) showed "Out of stock" at capture time but are permanent menu items with real prices, so kept.

name: Rubio's Coastal Grill
notes: Permanently closed. Corporate site's own location page (canonical URL matches batch record exactly) reads "POWAY – Closed – This location is now closed. We invite you to visit our nearby restaurants in Scripps Ranch, Carmel Mountain Ranch, or Rancho Bernardo." Independently corroborated by Mapquest ("closed permanently as of 10/26/2025"), the location's own Facebook page ("closed permanently"), and Yelp listing ("RUBIO'S COASTAL GRILL - CLOSED"). Filed as not_found per closure rule.

name: The Invigatorium
notes: Own site (theinvigatorium.com) is behind a Vercel bot-check wall, no bypass found. DoorDash listing confirmed address match (631 Ninth Avenue) and shows a single category, "Real Friends", under a "Full Menu" heading with page-stated hours 8am-3:35pm; page states "Prices on this menu are set directly by the Merchant." Only 5 items, all drinks/cocktails (Negroni, espresso martini-style drinks, beer) - no coffee or breakfast-taco food items appear even though press coverage (Fox5, joe.coffee, Instagram) describes an extensive coffee/breakfast menu. Likely DoorDash only carries a bar/evening delivery subset, not the full physical menu, but could also be an incomplete capture (address-gated full menu view did not fully load via automation). Filed as found with low confidence given the gap between this listing and known real-world menu breadth; worth a second look with a live address entered on doordash.com.

name: Taqueria El Cino
notes: Own site's homepage (elcinotaqueria.com) is live and current (Last-Modified Feb 2026, current hours listed), but its own /menu/ path is hijacked and 301-redirects to an unrelated Spanish poetry site (laspoesias.com) - a likely compromised-path hack, not proof of closure since the root domain is healthy. Yelp and Mapquest both label this location "CLOSED", contradicting the live DoorDash listing which shows an active "Full Menu" with stated hours, 4.5-star rating from 1k+ orders, and the disclaimer "Prices on this menu are set directly by the Merchant" (address matches: 1719 Palm Avenue). Filed as found from DoorDash given the live-menu evidence outweighs the aggregator "closed" labels, but the closure signal is worth a second look. 76 dishes across 12 sections (Tortas, Tacos, Burritos, Tostadas, Birria, Nachos, Quesadillas, Mulas & Vampiros, Papas Fritas, Postres, Bebidas, Breakfast). Cross-check: an old SinglePlatform listing (places.singleplatform.com) shows notably lower prices for some overlapping items (e.g. Carne Asada Taco $2.85 vs $4.50 here, Carne Asada Burrito $8.50 vs $13.75 here) but the ratio is inconsistent across items (not a flat markup), consistent with SinglePlatform being a stale snapshot rather than DoorDash inflating prices.

name: L'atelier de Paris
notes: Own domain (latelierdeparis.com) is live (Cloudflare, current Last-Modified) with matching address/phone, but its rendered page content is suspicious - it ends with literal text "This is the free demo result. You can also download a complete website from archive.org," which reads like boilerplate from a site-cloning/demo tool rather than the restaurant's own authored copy, so it was not used as a pricing source. Instead found the restaurant's real ordering platform via search: Clover Online Ordering (clover.com/online-ordering/latelier-de-paris-new-carlsbad-carlsbad), a JS-rendered SPA (no prices in static HTML, curl returns only a JS-required shell) - rendered live via browser and extracted full priced menu (133 items across 19 sections: coffee/tea, cold drinks, breakfast, omelets, crepes, French toast, sides, salads, burgers, sandwiches, soups, dinner entrees, kids menu). Page showed restaurant as currently "Closed" / "not accepting online orders right now" at fetch time, which is normal off-hours status, not a closure signal - address (7150 Avenida Encinas, Carlsbad) and phone ((760) 918-3473) match batch record exactly, and independent listings (Yelp, TripAdvisor, Instagram @latelier.carlsbad, Visit Carlsbad directory, Carlsbad Chamber) all show it as an active, currently-operating business as of search results. High item count and internal consistency (realistic French-cafe pricing, .00/.50 endings) support genuine merchant-set prices.

name: Tavola Nostra Pizzeria e Cucina
notes: Own site (tavolanostrapizzeria.com, WordPress) has a full text menu with descriptions but no prices; own Toast ordering platform (linked from the site) server-renders the priced menu directly in static HTML. 33 dishes across 5 sections (Antipasti, Insalata, Pinsa Romana, 12" Pizza Classica, Pasta). Toast's "Featured Items" carousel duplicated 3 items already listed under their real category (Classic Pepperoni, Pasta al Pesto, Arugula Salad) - those duplicates were dropped, keeping one instance of each. Soups/Dolci sections seen on the own-site menu were not present in the Toast page's rendered categories (likely paginated/lazy-loaded further down, not captured by static fetch) - menu may be incomplete beyond what's listed here.

name: Cocina 35 brunch
notes: Router found no known ordering platform on cocina35.com; own site's menu page (cocina35.com/cocina-menu/) confirms this location (1201 1st St, Coronado) and lists dish descriptions but explicitly states "Prices vary by item" with no actual prices in the HTML. Found priced menu via Uber Eats store page (title-matched "Cocina 35 - Coronado" at the same address, confirmed via live browser render since curl returned only a 404 shell for this JS SPA). 44 dishes across 10 sections. Dropped Uber Eats' "Featured items" carousel (a duplicate top-liked subset of items already listed under their real category with matching prices). Note: the site's own category tabs listed BEBIDAS and POSTRES twice each with different item sets and different prices for same-named items (e.g. Concha $3.50 in the first Postres list vs Concha $4.00 in the second) - both sets captured verbatim and disambiguated as "BEBIDAS"/"BEBIDAS (2)" and "POSTRES"/"POSTRES (2)" by page order rather than guessing which is dine-in vs to-go pricing.
